name: Into The Mountain
storyline: Explore the Peak of Tauema and uncover the mystery surrounding it, as a 12-year-old boy, named Ed, is drawn into events far beyond his comprehension.
summary:
Into The Mountain is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience that begins as a cozy 2D platformer and slowly turns into something far more unsettling.

The game moves between genres and viewpoints, expanding into 3D atmospheric horror as the sense of familiarity begins to crack.

You explore the Peak of Tauema through the eyes of Ed, a 12-year-old boy drawn toward events far beyond his comprehension. As the adventure unfolds the world shifts. Rules change. Spaces transform. What once felt simple becomes ambiguous.

Into The Mountain is built around tension and discovery. The experience unfolds in layers, blending platforming, environmental storytelling, and shifting perspectives to create unease.

The game also uses subtle personalization. Small elements of the world respond to how you play, creating moments that feel intimate and unpredictable without breaking immersion.
